en/hero: FSD engaged. Hi, I'm the autopilot and I'll drive you through the site of Zdeněk Mazurák — a senior backend engineer from Olomouc. Hands off the wheel.
en/about: Zdeněk has been programming since he was twelve. For over six years he's owned the backend of the Worldee travel platform, and lately he's all in on AI.
en/stack: This is his stack. Expert in PHP and Nette, strong in C#, TypeScript and React — and he works with AI agents every day.
en/projects: Now the best part — projects. Each one opens as a 3D hologram. Let me show you five, and for three I'll play a narrated recording from production.
en/worldee: Let's start with Worldee — the travel platform where Zdeněk has owned the backend for over six years. Trip planning, a travel diary, flights and car rentals.
en/workmux: Next, WorkMux — his main project. Many AI agents at once, each with its own Docker stack right on your machine. Here's the video from the new site.
en/drive: Drive is multiplayer driving across the real Czech Republic, right in the browser. There, you drive — not me.
en/experience: Career: Worldee since 2019, before that Quadient and enterprise development in C# and .NET.
en/education: He studied computer science at Palacký University Olomouc, and electrical engineering before that.
en/game: One more thing — there's a hidden game on this site. The solar system with planets at their real positions. First, a rocket to the Moon.
en/throw: And now the point of the game: grab the Earth, pull it back like a slingshot and fling it into the Sun. Like this.
en/contact: And we've arrived. If you want to talk WorkMux, AI or backend, drop him a line. Autopilot signing off.
cs/demo-workmux-product-1: Tohle je minutové video z nového webu WorkMuxu. Začíná problémem, který zná každý: agent pracuje a ty jen čekáš.
cs/demo-workmux-product-2: Ve WorkMuxu pustíš víc agentů vedle sebe, každého na vlastní úkol. Vlevo je vidíš všechny.
cs/demo-workmux-product-3: Jenže dva agenti nad jednou databází si navzájem rozbijí testy. Worktree oddělí soubory, ale ne služby.
cs/demo-workmux-product-4: Proto WorkMux dá každému agentovi vlastní Docker Compose stack — vlastní databázi, Redis i síť. A běží to na tvém stroji.
cs/demo-workmux-product-5: Agent nehlásí hotovo naslepo. Pustí testy i appku proti skutečným službám a ty se do ní rovnou proklikneš.
cs/demo-workmux-product-6: Práci pak zkontroluješ jako pull request. Okomentuješ řádek a agent to opraví.
cs/demo-workmux-product-7: A když tě agent potřebuje, přijde notifikace a odpovíš mu z mobilu.
cs/demo-workmux-product-8: Každý agent má vlastní stack. A mimochodem — i tenhle web vzniká přes WorkMux.
cs/demo-workmux-landing-1: Na novém webu si rovnou proklikáš skutečné rozhraní: sessions, rozhovor s agentem a změny v kódu. Bez registrace.
cs/demo-workmux-landing-2: Začít jde zdarma — dvě sessions naráz na vlastním stroji, s vlastním účtem Claude nebo Codex.
cs/demo-workmux-compare-1: Srovnání v kostce: worktree izoluje jen soubory, cloudoví agenti běží ve VM dodavatele. WorkMux izoluje celý stack a běží u tebe.
cs/demo-drive-flyover-1: Tohle je záběr přímo ze hry. Let nad Prahou, kterou Drive postavil z OpenStreetMap.
cs/demo-drive-flyover-2: Domy, ulice, parky i stromy se generují z mapových dat. Nic z toho nikdo ručně nemodeloval.
cs/demo-drive-flyover-3: Vltava teče ve skutečném korytě a přes ni vedou mosty.
cs/demo-drive-flyover-4: V dálce Hradčany. A terén pod nimi je skutečný — Petřín opravdu stoupá.
cs/demo-drive-flyover-5: Celé to běží v prohlížeči i na mobilu a jezdíš tu s kamarády v jednom sdíleném světě.
cs/demo-drive-shot1-1: Praha z výšky. Každý dům, každá ulice i řeka jsou ze skutečné mapy.
cs/demo-drive-shot2-1: Obloha a denní doba jsou dynamické — tady nábřeží při západu slunce, s lampami a stromořadím.
cs/demo-drive-shot3-1: Podvečerní opar nad Vltavou. Světlo se mění podle toho, kolik je ve hře hodin.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-1: OverCup je herní portál pro dva: přes třicet her přímo v prohlížeči, bez instalace.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-2: Deskovky, karty i slovní hry — od šachů a Go po Uno, poker nebo kulečník.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-3: Každý hráč má svou lobby a kamaráda pozve odkazem nebo QR kódem.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-4: Hostitel spustí hru, soupeř potvrdí, že je připravený, a hraje se.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-5: Tahy letí přes socket.io a stav partie drží Redis, takže server jde škálovat do šířky.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-6: Pět v řadě a je rozhodnuto. Odvetu dáš jedním klikem.
cs/demo-overcup-piskvorky-7: A soupeř může pogratulovat v chatu lobby.
cs/demo-overcup-sachy-1: Šachy: stejná lobby, jiná hra. Bílý táhne první.
cs/demo-overcup-sachy-2: Pravidla hlídá server. Klient dostane jen tahy, které jsou zrovna povolené.
cs/demo-overcup-sachy-3: Bílá dáma míří na pole f7 — slabinu, kterou kryje jen král.
cs/demo-overcup-sachy-4: Mat na čtyři tahy, takzvaný školní mat. Celá partie trvala pár vteřin.
cs/demo-overcup-lobby-1: Úvodní stránka: vybereš hru a vpravo máš odkaz a QR kód pro kamaráda.
cs/nowity: Nowity je jeho realtime framework. Data z Postgresu tečou rovnou do prohlížeče jako živé objekty — bez ručního načítání a obnovování stránky. Stojí na něm i jeho multi-tenant CMS Nowity Space.
cs/overcup: A nakonec OverCup — online deskovky pro dva. Podívej se na dvě skutečné partie.
en/demo-workmux-product-1: This is a one-minute video from the new WorkMux site. It opens with a problem everyone knows: the agent works and you just wait.
en/demo-workmux-product-2: In WorkMux you run several agents side by side, each on its own task. You see them all on the left.
en/demo-workmux-product-3: But two agents on one database break each other's tests. Worktrees isolate files, not services.
en/demo-workmux-product-4: So WorkMux gives every agent its own Docker Compose stack — its own database, Redis and network. Running on your machine.
en/demo-workmux-product-5: The agent doesn't claim done blindly. It runs the tests and the app against real services, and you can click straight into it.
en/demo-workmux-product-6: Then you review the work like a pull request. Comment on a line and the agent fixes it.
en/demo-workmux-product-7: And when an agent needs you, you get a notification and answer from your phone.
en/demo-workmux-product-8: Every agent gets its own stack. And by the way — this very site is built with WorkMux too.
en/demo-workmux-landing-1: The new site lets you click through the real interface: sessions, the conversation with the agent and the code changes. No sign-up.
en/demo-workmux-landing-2: It's free to start — two sessions at once on your own machine, with your own Claude or Codex account.
en/demo-workmux-compare-1: The comparison in a nutshell: worktrees isolate only files, cloud agents run in the vendor's VM. WorkMux isolates the whole stack and runs on your machine.
en/demo-drive-flyover-1: This is captured straight from the game: a flight over Prague, which Drive builds from OpenStreetMap.
en/demo-drive-flyover-2: Houses, streets, parks and trees are all generated from map data. Nobody modelled any of it by hand.
en/demo-drive-flyover-3: The Vltava runs in its real riverbed, with bridges across it.
en/demo-drive-flyover-4: Prague Castle in the distance — and the terrain beneath it is real; Petřín hill actually rises.
en/demo-drive-flyover-5: All of it runs in the browser, even on a phone, and you drive with friends in one shared world.
en/demo-drive-shot1-1: Prague from above. Every house, every street and the river come from the real map.
en/demo-drive-shot2-1: The sky and time of day are dynamic — here the riverside at sunset, with street lamps and tree lines.
en/demo-drive-shot3-1: Evening haze over the Vltava. The light changes with the in-game time of day.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-1: OverCup is a two-player game portal: over thirty games right in the browser, nothing to install.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-2: Board games, card games and word games — from chess and Go to Uno, poker and pool.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-3: Every player has a lobby and invites a friend with a link or a QR code.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-4: The host starts the game, the opponent confirms they're ready, and you're playing.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-5: Moves travel over socket.io and the game state lives in Redis, so the server scales horizontally.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-6: Five in a row and it's over. A rematch is one click away.
en/demo-overcup-piskvorky-7: And the opponent can say well played in the lobby chat.
en/demo-overcup-sachy-1: Chess: same lobby, different game. White moves first.
en/demo-overcup-sachy-2: The server enforces the rules. The client only ever gets the moves that are legal right now.
en/demo-overcup-sachy-3: White's queen is heading for f7 — the weak square only the king defends.
en/demo-overcup-sachy-4: Mate in four, the classic scholar's mate. The whole game took a few seconds.
en/demo-overcup-lobby-1: The home page: pick a game, and on the right there's a link and a QR code for your friend.
en/nowity: Nowity is his realtime framework. Data from Postgres flows straight into the browser as live objects — no manual fetching, no page reloads. His multi-tenant CMS, Nowity Space, runs on it too.
en/overcup: And finally OverCup — online board games for two. Here are two real matches.
